description: This file defines the class OAuth2ClientsViewEdit, which extends the ViewEdit class to provide a customized editing interface for OAuth2 client configurations within SuiteCRM. It contains methods to determine the view type based on OAuth grant types and user actions, and overrides the display method to set the form name accordingly.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientsViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to manage OAuth2 client editing views, setting view types based on grant types and user actions, and controlling form display.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Returns the metadata file for the view, calling parent method after setting view type.

methods.name: setViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type and form name based on OAuth2 grant type and current user action.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Sets the form name property and calls parent's display method to render the view.
